title.en: A New Account of the Tales of the World

review.en: More than a thousand short anecdotes of scholars, generals and eccentrics from the Han to the Eastern Jin, sorted into thirty-six kinds of virtue and folly. Many entries are a single exchange or gesture, yet a whole temperament shows through. It fixed the image of the free-spirited Wei-Jin gentleman and supplied Chinese writing with idioms ever since.
review.zh: 南朝宋刘义庆主持编成，一千多则汉末至东晋名士的言行轶事，分三十六门。往往只是一句应答、一个动作，人物的风神便立住了。魏晋风度的形象多半出自这里，后世的成语典故也不断从中取用。适合随手翻开，读三两则就合上。
